Wingless.purpose: Test full index T's real measured wall-time benefit under same strictly enforced total virtual/process memory budget, and record actual peak RSS and Python heap. No hidden free scratch memory.
Wingless.memory_enforcement: Linux resource.RLIMIT_AS hard cap, Windows SetInformationJobObject JobObjectExtendedLimitInformation JOB_OBJECT_LIMIT_PROCESS_MEMORY cap, both attach current worker process; refuse unsupported or failed enforcement.
Wingless.measure: PeakWorkingSetSize Windows; VmHWM Linux; tracemalloc inference peak; virtual address space under enforced cap; raw public edge scans; raw bit operations; scratch entries
Wingless.reference: All original signed S/T/U pretrained weights immutable; byte-for-byte hex logit/predictions same per graph; strong fixed baseline separate. Include OS and worker fingerprints.

Yggdrasil.purpose: Explain calibration/score drift when exact public causal prefix survives, without introducing new learned allocations or changing original model.
Yggdrasil.model_source: Original authenticated FIT weights only, no training
trace_details: per-hop score on exact public causal route
accumulated learned S value-credit contribution per exact route
Yggdrasil.science_guard: Unique reference causal path is found only by post-inference evaluator, never supplied as a model feature; traced logits must equal unchanged originals in hex; exactly 7 active +9 retained.
Yggdrasil.analysis: Difference in full accumulator/decision score between model arms on source-identical pairs by hop and depth; report no evidence of eviction only where observed. No model updates or selection based on DEV.
